Here, coherent means having the same frequency and a phase difference that stays steady.

Magnification alone does not settle whether details can be distinguished.", "id": null, "label": null, "printed_page": 225, "source_refs": ["p0235#7", "p0236#1"], "source_text": "**显微镜和望远镜的分辨本领**　光的波动性使得用显微镜观察和辨别物体的细节或很小的物体的可能性受到限制. 衍射使我们不能得到细小物体的清晰的像，因为光并不是严格地直线传播，而是绕过物体，因此，得到的像是模糊的。如果小物体的模糊的像混合在一起，那么无论怎样放大也不可能看清物体的各个部分.当物体的大小小于光波的波长时，就会发生这种情况.", "changes": ["translation", "explanation", "layout"], "numeric_changes": [], "historical_entities": []}, {"kind": "p", "text": "Diffraction also limits a telescope.

The source says the limiting angular separation is determined by the ratio of wavelength to objective diameter.
